# Ann Gravells

> Professional resources and expert guidance for Further Education teachers, trainers, and assessors from award-winning author and education consultant Ann Gravells.

Ann Gravells is a leading FE sector expert and prolific textbook author specializing in teacher training qualifications, assessment practices, and professional development. The site provides comprehensive resources including published textbooks, downloadable materials, sector guidance, and consultancy services for education professionals.

## Key Topics

- Further Education
- Teacher Training
- Assessment
- Professional Development
- Teaching Qualifications
- Award in Education and Training
- Certificate in Education and Training
- Vocational Education
- Quality Assurance
- Apprenticeships
- Digital Skills
- CPD Modules
- Educational Content
- Teaching Resources
- QTLS

## About Ann Gravells

- [Ann Gravells](https://www.anngravells.com/about/ann): Professional biography of Ann Gravells, FE expert and textbook author.
- [Consultancy](https://www.anngravells.com/about/consultancy): Ann Gravells' consultancy services for education and training sector.
- [Testimonials](https://www.anngravells.com/about/testimonials): Customer feedback and testimonials for Ann Gravells' training and resources.

## Textbooks & Publications

- [Text books](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/all-books): Complete catalog of textbooks by Ann Gravells for FE and training sector.

- [Recent books](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/latest-projects): New and recent publications by Ann Gravells for 2024-2025.
- [e-books](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/ebooks): E-book editions via Sage, Kindle and mobile platforms.
- [Audio books](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/audio-books): Audio book formats available on Amazon Kindle and mobile platforms.
- [book-reviews](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/book-reviews): Reader feedback and reviews of Ann Gravells' textbooks.
- [Reading list](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/reading-list): Curated reading list for teacher training and professional development.
- [bulkorders](https://www.anngravells.com/anns-books/bulk-orders): Bulk ordering information with wholesale pricing and free delivery.

## FE Sector Guidance

- [Information](https://www.anngravells.com/information/index): Comprehensive FE sector guidance for teachers, trainers and assessors.
- [Assessment](https://www.anngravells.com/information/assessment): Assessment methods and guidance for assessing learning in FE.
- [Apprenticeships](https://www.anngravells.com/information/apprenticeships): Apprenticeship programs and end-point assessment guidance.
- [Embedding](https://www.anngravells.com/information/embedding): Teaching strategies for embedding English, maths and digital skills.
- [Evaluation](https://www.anngravells.com/information/evaluation): Reflection and evaluation frameworks for FE practitioners.
